comments.author: @pamyvilla
comments.text:
This is how I want to answer the question…

I was waiting for a blessing that I so needed. It didn’t come. But I need it so much and now I am in a desperate situation. My thoughts are telling me maybe I am not doing enough or I am doing the wrong things. Maybe I do not deserve to be blessed.

So in a way, this message this morning is I think negating those thoughts. I trust God, I do. I know He loves me and all but just now I am scared and worried. I don’t know if those can combine.

It’s like the song LORD I AM NOT OK BUT I’M STILL HERE…
